name: @intent/solana-devnet-adapter
description: TESTNET-R1 settlement adapter (T1 skeleton). Chain is a Settlement Adapter only: it consumes GP4-produced authorization, enforces DENY BEFORE TX on every input mismatch, and carries NO chain capability while Appendix A constants are unpinned. Economic uniqueness maps (escrow_ref, outcome_receipt_hash) to a deterministic release PDA via the frozen EconomicReleaseDigest formula.
